description: first block of the load-more walk of 13.12: two cards and the `data-test="load-more"` control. One of three cumulative documents — block 2 repeats these two cards and adds two, block 3 adds two more and drops the control. Cumulative because the real control appends to one document, so each reading carries every block revealed so far; a non-cumulative set would let an adapter pass here while losing the earlier blocks in production.
